column2: Even after class ended,<LF>I came across Nanairo still doing physical training on her own.
Still at it? You shouldn't push yourself too hard.<LF>Strength doesn't grow from the time and reps you put in, you know.
Of course, I believe I understand that.
...Even so, if I'm not moving like this,<LF>I end up feeling anxious.
I have far too many shortcomings, after all...
All right. Then today I'll stick with you<LF>until you're satisfied, Nanairo.
Huh...? No, I never meant to drag you into this...
You must be tired as well,<LF>so I would feel awful making you stay behind with me.
If anything, watching you work so hard gave me energy back.<LF>Let me burn off this surplus energy.
Fufu, then please do.<LF>I'll be taking some of your time.
Then let's do a little more.<LF>But when I say that's enough, you stop right away.
Switching gears is what matters with things like this.<LF>Deciding where to stop sharpens your focus and gives better results.
I see...! Understood.<LF>Then please keep me company, just a little longer.
Yeah. I'll be right here watching over you.
And so Nanairo and I, having wrapped up cleanly,<LF>headed home together.
